main_text.p: annes? Quid porro Photius in Synodo? Praesidet ipse, Legatis Romanis subfellia exhibet, ingrediendi alijs in Synodum facultatem facit, Locum tenentium Patriarchalium Sediū venerationes, & cultus recipit; Pontificij ac si essent ex leui plebecula despiciuntur, decreta ipse sancit, & leges dat, Pontificij audiunt, nec audent hiscere. Satis illis est, si rogantibus, & supplicantibus ipsis, auctoritas summa Photij praecipiat. Photius a crimine vendicatur, Romanae Ecclesiae Pontifices schismatis auctores decernuntur, & culpa omnis in Romanam Ecclesiam reiicitur. Scribat quidquid velit Pontifex Romanus, Photiani in ea Synodo iudices facti quaecunque iusta, & legitima iudicant, amplectuntur, & recipiunt; quasi vero Romani Pontifices iniusta, & [illegible, ~12 letters] , & praeter ius falsque multa praecipiant, & mandent quorum ipsi iudices constituuntur. Tandemque ipse Pontificijs sequentibus Synodum Oecumenicam sub Adriano, & Romanas sub Nicolao, & Adriano contra semetipsum irritat, illisque hanc suam substituit, & additionem in Symbolo condemnat. An est aliquid simile in alijs Synodis? Quis unquam similia audijt? Nonne somnia isthaec sunt? Synodum Oecumenicam Pontificis Romani auctoritate, & alio-

page.notes: Greek word after "& " (between "Pontifices iniusta," and "& praeter ius") is printed in a different, smaller hand and is not legible enough to transcribe; the placeholder stands in its place. The "sediū" tilde is read as an abbreviation for -um. Printed page number 63 is read from the top right; the scan is slightly skewed. Line-end hyphen in "alio-" continues on the next page. Some letters of the first line are faint (e.g. "annes?" is a fragment carried over from the previous page).
